{{Article status|status=Draft|mode=Both|noindex=yes|reviewed=2026-08-24|reviewer=Sythan|source_quality=EDCD outfitting data plus current mining workflow research|uncertainty=Exact per-variant outfitting statistics and fissure-strength details still need direct Live-game verification.}}

{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Seismic Charge Launcher''' is the core-mining hardpoint used to place charges in asteroid fissures. Correct charge placement cracks a core asteroid and exposes deposits for collection.

{{Draft warning}}

== Mining role ==

{{#invoke:Mining|equipmentNote|page=Seismic Charge Launcher}}

The launcher is only one part of [[Core Mining]]. A complete core-mining fit also needs search support, collection support, a refinery, cargo space, and usually an [[Abrasion Blaster]] to remove deposits after the detonation.
